name: finish
description: End the current role and return a ResultCard to the caller. Always use status "success" when the task is complete, "error" when it cannot be completed, or "needs_clarification" when essential information is missing.

summary.description: Plain-language summary of what was done or why the role is finishing with this status.

artifacts.description: Optional list of workspace-relative paths produced or modified by this role.

error.description: Required when status is "error". Describes the failure.

kind.description: One of the executor error kinds: invalid_tool_call, unknown_tool, invalid_arguments, timeout, llm_unavailable, context_budget_exceeded, tool_budget_exceeded, token_budget_exceeded, loop_detected, compaction_failed.
